name: Wild Gunman
source: You are a sheriff on a very, very remote planet. Your planet is somewhat backward. Your government doesn’t control other planets and has little interest in what lies beyond space. Located on the very edge of the galaxy, your planet attracts all sorts of criminal scum seeking a quiet hideout where no one will look for them. As a result, crime on your planet has skyrocketed. Due to some of your past misdeeds, you, as a sheriff, have been sent to the remote towns of your planet to dispense justice.
translation: 你是一颗极其偏远星球上的警长。你所在的星球颇为落后，政府既没有统辖其他星球的能力，对太空彼岸的事物也缺乏兴趣。正因地处银河系最边缘，各路穷凶极恶的人渣纷纷涌向这里，企图找个无人搜寻的僻静藏身之所，星球上的犯罪率也随之急剧飙升。由于过往犯下的一些过错，身为警长的你被发配到了星球上的偏远小镇，去那里伸张正义。
